preferences.ai.security.customHeadersDes: Exact, case-insensitive header names to always mask on top of the built-in list.

preferences.ai.security.intro: Sensitive data is automatically redacted before context is sent to AI providers. Turn off protections if needed, or add custom headers and variables to redact.
preferences.ai.security.redactBodyDesc: Masks values under keys like password, *_token, secret in JSON and GraphQL variables. Structure and non-sensitive fields still pass through.
preferences.ai.security.redactHeadersDes: Masks Authorization, cookies, API keys and other credential-bearing headers in the request context.
preferences.ai.security.redactResponseDe: Sends the response as a shape only ！ real values replaced with type placeholders (&ltstring&gt, &ltnumber&gt). Turn off to send the actual response body.
preferences.ai.security.redactVariablesD: Masks values whose names look like secrets. Variables explicitly marked secret are always redacted regardless of this switch.
